changelog:
v2.8.0 — 📡 EMPIRE TALK: INTERNET CALLS

The dream feature is here. Voice calls + chat between Empire handles — and since the call stream belongs to US, recording captures both sides in quality normal call recording can never reach.

• Claim @yourhandle — no phone numbers, zero personal data
• 📞 WebRTC voice calls between handles
• 💬 Recent Chats hub — WhatsApp-style: all conversations and calls in one place, previews, tap to open
• 🔴 In-call recording (WAV, lands in your recordings library)
• 🔇 Mute, timer, incoming call cards with Answer/Reject
• Security: meeting point is RLS-guarded — only Empire apps can read/write

Honest Phase 1 limits: incoming calls ring while the Empire app is open; push-ringing with the app closed is next (the Firebase engine is wired and waiting). Both sides need internet. The APK grew to ~43MB — that is the WebRTC engine inside.

HOW TO USE: open Empire Talk → claim your handle → tell your people to install the Empire + claim theirs → call and chat by handle.
